title: Detailed cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Cheese wedge main body, side face -->
  <polygon points="12,72 72,84 72,52 12,42" fill="#F5C842"/>
  <!-- Top surface -->
  <polygon points="12,42 72,52 88,38 28,28" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <!-- Front face -->
  <polygon points="72,52 72,84 88,70 88,38" fill="#E8A921"/>
  <!-- Rind edge highlight along front bottom -->
  <polygon points="12,72 72,84 72,80 12,68" fill="#FADB6B"/>
  <!-- Rind edge top of front -->
  <polygon points="12,42 12,48 28,34 28,28" fill="#FFE58F"/>
  <!-- Holes on top surface -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="38" rx="5" ry="3.2" fill="#D89A1E"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="42" rx="4" ry="2.6" fill="#D89A1E"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="48" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#D89A1E"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="38" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#D89A1E"/>
  <!-- Holes on front face -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="64" rx="4.5" ry="6" fill="#C98A16"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="60" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#C98A16"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="3" ry="3.8" fill="#C98A16"/>
  <!-- Hole highlights -->
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="62" rx="2" ry="2.5" fill="#E8A921"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="36" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#F5C842"/>
  <!-- Small hole on side face (triangle side) -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="62" rx="3.2" ry="4" fill="#D89A1E"/>
  <!-- Cute face on front -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="58" r="2.6" fill="#4A2E0A"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="55" r="2.6" fill="#4A2E0A"/>
  <circle cx="60.8" cy="57.2" r="0.9" fill="#FFE58F"/>
  <circle cx="72.8" cy="54.2" r="0.9" fill="#FFE58F"/>
  <path d="M62 66 Q66 70 71 66.5" stroke="#4A2E0A" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="64" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#FF9E6B" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="77" cy="61" rx="3" ry="1.8" fill="#FF9E6B" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
